title: ICAR-IIMR Corn Common Rust (Puccinia sorghi) Advisory
content:
Crop: Corn / Maize (Zea mays)
Disease: Common Rust (Puccinia sorghi)
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://iimr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Identification & Symptoms:
• Small circular to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered over both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
• Pustules rupture the leaf epidermis, discharging powdery brown urediniospores.

2. Management Practices:
• Cultural: Plant resistant hybrids recommended by PAU/ICAR; avoid excessively dense planting.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved): Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0-2.5 g/L of water or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1.0 mL/L at the first appearance of pustules.
• Safety & PHI: Pre-Harvest Interval is 21 days.
source_name: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR) / PAU
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0-2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1.0 mL/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Mancozeb 75% WP CIBRC approved for maize rust.
content_hi:
मक्का सामान्य रतुआ (Common Rust - Puccinia sorghi):
लक्षण: पत्तियों की दोनों सतहों पर कत्थई-भूरे रंग के उभरे हुए चूर्ण भरे फफोले।
उपचार: मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.0 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। PHI: 21 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIMR Corn Northern Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum) Advisory
content:
Crop: Corn / Maize (Zea mays)
Disease: Northern Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum)
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIMR / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://iimr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Symptoms & Management:
• Long elliptical grayish-green or tan cigar-shaped lesions (3-15 cm long) on leaves, coalescing to cause large blighted leaf areas.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved): Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1.0 mL/L. Repeat after 15 days if favorable cool, wet conditions persist. PHI: 21 days.

मक्का उत्तरी पत्ती झुलसा (Northern Leaf Blight - Exserohilum turcicum):
उपचार: मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.0 ग्राम/लीटर पानी। PHI: 21 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIMR Corn Healthy Crop Maintenance Advisory
content:
Crop: Corn / Maize (Zea mays)
Disease: Healthy Crop Maintenance
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIMR Ludhiana
Official Bulletin: https://iimr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

• Balanced nitrogen split doses at knee-high and tasseling stages, adequate weed management, fall armyworm pheromone trapping.
